name: judge
description: Phase 1 — thin wrapper over gaia-testbench's LLM judge (PLAN.md §2.6 / IMPLEMENTATION.md §2.6). Runs inline as a `command`; called by eval-case (and by teacher's rescore). Scores the artifact + reasoning trace already written into a case workdir against the task's 1-3 multi-criterion rubric (correctness / verification / code_quality), model = $GAIA_JUDGE_MODEL or claude-opus-5. Writes <workdir>/quality.json and returns the compact per-criterion scores. Reused, not built — the real judging lives in gaia_testbench/quality.py::score_artifact; scripts/judge_case.py is the adapter.

arguments.name: workdir
arguments.description: absolute path of the case workdir holding the artifact + reasoning_trace.jsonl ($1)

arguments.name: task_id
arguments.description: gaia-testbench task id whose rubric to judge against ($2)
